title: Syslog decoders
intro: A decoder recognises messages from a device (match conditions), parses the content (kv, JSON, CSV, patterns) and assigns event fields – detection rules work on them (product: fortigate, mikrotik…). Decoders are tried in order (higher priority first); a message without a decoder is stored as syslog.generic. Changes from the panel take effect in the normalizers within a few seconds and do not change events already stored.
noNats: The panel is not connected to NATS – saved changes reach the normalizers only after the connection is restored.
wizardTitle: Decoder wizard – mark the fields in sample messages

delivery.ok: saved; the normalizers apply the change within a few seconds
delivery.no_nats: saved; no NATS connection – the normalizers get the change once it is restored
delivery.failed: saved; delivery to the normalizers failed – the panel retries within 5 minutes

result.noPatternTip: The decoder matches, but no pattern parsed the content – only the text remains
result.shadowedTip: The tested decoder matches, but another one was chosen first (higher priority) – change priority or match

editor.intro: The test decodes the samples with the set of running decoders in which this definition replaces its counterpart – so you also see which decoder wins (priority). Empty sample list – test on the samples from the definition (samples). Nothing is saved.
editor.samples: Samples – one message per line, with the syslog header
editor.notePlaceholder: e.g. added a VPN sign-in pattern
editor.noMessages: No messages in the selected period
editor.manyPeers: Samples from different senders – check decoders with a peer condition using the sender filter
editor.idMismatch: The id in the definition ({{id}}) differs from the edited decoder ({{current}})

versions.none: No changes from the panel – the version built into the program is running.

action.restoreInfo: The custom definition will be removed (it stays in the history) and the version built into the program will take over.

labelHint.time: event time (better than the header time)
labelHint.outcome: success / failure – set the values below
labelHint.any: a part that varies between messages, not stored (e.g. protocol, session number)
labelHint.match: a constant part by which the decoder recognises these messages

wizard.yamlDescription: Created with the decoder wizard in the panel (fields marked in sample messages).
wizard.noUnrecognized: No unrecognised messages from the last 7 days
wizard.selectFirst: First select a part of the message with the mouse (or drop a label on a word)
wizard.customName: Custom field: enter a name (lower-case letters, digits, dots), e.g. vpn.tunnel
wizard.overlap: The part overlaps one already marked – click the old one to remove it

err.exists: id “{{id}}” already belongs to decoder “{{title}}” – change the id or tick “replace existing”
err.dataset: dataset: lower-case letters, digits, . _ - (not windows.* or syslog.generic)
err.noField: mark at least one field in the message
err.noPattern: mark fields in at least one message
err.matchEach: recognition: mark a constant part (“recognition”) in every pattern or enable recognition by patterns
err.noMatch: set how to recognise these messages (program, host, sender or a constant part)
err.outcome: outcome: enter which values mean success and which mean failure
err.noYear: time without a year – remove the time label (the header time is enough) or mark the year too
err.zone: time zone: e.g. Europe/Warsaw or UTC

wizard.stale: Samples changed – click “Load” so the wizard and the check use them.
wizard.samplesPlaceholder: one syslog message per line (with header), e.g. from the quarantine or a file
wizard.markHint: Select a part below with the mouse, then click a label or drag it onto the selection. Clicking a marked part removes the label. Mark each kind of message (e.g. successful and failed sign-in) separately – the wizard turns them into separate patterns.
wizard.patternNoMatch: the pattern does not match this message – check the marks
wizard.kvHint: Assign labels to the message fields. “require” – the message must have this field (recognition).
wizard.name: Name
wizard.matchTitle: Recognition – all ticked conditions must match
wizard.byPatterns: only messages matching the marked patterns (recommended)
wizard.byPatternsHint: otherwise the decoder takes every message meeting the conditions above, even one it cannot extract fields from
wizard.matchFragmentHint: Mark a constant part of the message used for recognition with the “recognition” label (in every pattern).
wizard.patternAlso: – also matches the pattern from message {{list}}; the first one applies, check the action and outcome
wizard.legend: ✓ – recognised by this decoder with fields, ✗ – not (click to mark it as another pattern), ↷ – handled by another decoder.
